messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High backend queue depth for gen service in us-west-2. Error rate > 3% and 95th latency spike. Paging #eng-oncall. incident id INC-2026-0421
Jamie: oncall here, looking
Kevin: seeing runtime queue depth at 72/80, GPU batch sizes collapsing, KV cache thrashing
Kevin: NGINX 429s from rate limiter increased, per-customer rate limited buckets full
Jamie: what's customer impact? any high-paying customers?
Alex: Support: we're getting multiple tickets from AcmeCorp and BetaApps — both report 429s and partial responses
Jamie: ok triage plan: quick mitigation - enable circuit-breaker on gen route to open at error rate 2.5% and reduce max_in_flight to 6 for gen workers; also disable embeddings background prefetch for now
Kevin: can do. changing live flags
Kevin: ```sh
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://admin.redwood/api/flags -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","circuit_open_error_rate":0.025,"max_in_flight":6}'
```
ops-bot: policy update applied: /v1/generate max_in_flight=6 circuit_threshold=0.025 by Kevin
Jamie: enabling soft rate limit per-customer (5 rps) for non-enterprise
Kevin: also tuning generation timeout down from 30s->18s to free stuck requests
Jamie: ```json
{"route":"/v1/generate","max_latency_ms":18000}
```
Priya: I'll monitor dashboards and check error budget. Setting alert window to 1m
ops-bot: circuit opened for /v1/generate for 45s, shedding started
Kevin: seeing queue drop to 22 within 90s, 429s spiked briefly then fell
Alex: AcmeCorp reports partial recovery, BetaApps still sees higher retries but functional
Jamie: customer impact: ~0.6% of requests saw 429s during mitigation, highest for non-enterprise tiers. Communicated to Support to send status
Alex: sent message to AcmeCorp and BetaApps with known workaround (retry with jitter). Marking high-touch follow-up
Jamie: creating follow-up ticket INC-2026-0421-POSTMORTEM assigned to Kevin and Priya
Kevin: action items: investigate root cause of KV cache thrash, consider auto-scaling gen workers for sustained load
Priya: will keep monitoring next 2 hours and roll back soft rate limits once 95th latency <1.2s for 10m
Jamie: thanks team. If anything regresses, re-page. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated for now, monitoring
